name: Karasuma Kotarou
source:
“Ahh, stop arguing already!”

The protagonist’s classmate who’s been given the unwanted nickname “Omaru.” Since it was his fault that Michiru broke the statue, he also joins the Bureau for the Investigation of Special Affairs. He has the most common sense out of the three Bureau members, so he’s always mediating between Michiru and Ushio with phrases like “Now, now” and “Calm down.” He has a strong sense of responsibility, can’t leave distressed people alone, and has a caring, softhearted personality… but his bad luck gets him into all sorts of trouble. His hometown is out in the countryside, so he is unfamiliar with city life and gets surprised at various things.

[From the [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/leyline/]English official site[/url].]

[spoiler]Kotarou and Mutsuki are revealed to be alternate identities, except for the fact that Omaru was predominant over Mutsuki, whom Omaru was "occupying".

[From [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2015/02/13/the-finale-of-leyline-review-of-150130tokijikake-asagiri-ni-chiru-hana/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]][/spoiler]
translation:
“啊，别再吵了！”

主人公的同班同学，被人起了他并不喜欢的绰号“阿丸”。因为美知留打碎雕像是他的责任，他也加入了特殊事务调查局。三名调查局成员中，他最有常识，因此总是用“好了好了”“冷静一点”之类的话调解美知留和汐绪。他责任感很强，无法对陷入困境的人袖手旁观，性格体贴而温柔……但糟糕的运气总让他卷入各种麻烦。他的故乡在乡下，因此不熟悉城市生活，也会被各种事情吓一跳。

[来源：[url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/leyline/]英文官方网站[/url]。]

[spoiler]后来揭示，小太郎和睦月是两个不同的身份，只是阿丸占据了睦月的身体，且阿丸的人格占据主导。

[来源：[url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2015/02/13/the-finale-of-leyline-review-of-150130tokijikake-asagiri-ni-chiru-hana/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]][/spoiler]
